title: Exact finite compression loss and shorter cold rho horizon

claims.statement: The analytic supplied-P pairing inversion algorithm in proof.md has success at least 0.39 under its sole disclosed SHA-512 idealization. Total cold work H+R/20000 is below 2^(128291/1000) reference dense Fp12 equivalents, with H=K reference multiplications and R<=14720*K+2^90 other scalar instructions. Peak memory is below 2^50 bytes, advice zero. All preprocessing, trials, lookup, transfers, verification and G2 output are charged. This is an analytic heuristic bound, not a production execution.
